name: nop-ai-shell-bash-cst-frontend
description: Replace the hand-written BashLexer/BashSyntaxParser front-end in nop-ai-shell with a tree-sitter CST translator (nop-treesitter bash blob, corpus 100/100). Deliver a thin external interface (single entry point) whose coordination environment (command registry, checkers, fs, env, cwd, io, limits) is passed via a context object; extend the CommandExpression hierarchy with control flow (if/elif/else, while/until, for-in, break/continue/return) and condition semantics (exit-code conditions, test/[[ ]] builtins, $( ) recursion). Cover only the most common syntax; out-of-subset constructs are structurally rejected (node kind + source text + byte offset) instead of fail-fast ParseException. Terminal state: single bash syntax authority — hand-written lexer/parser deleted, golden-equivalence tests migrated. Roadmap: ai-dev/backlog/nop-ai-shell-bash-cst-frontend-roadmap.md. Constraint: only the parsing front-end changes; the io.nop.treesitter.shell analysis layer (never evaluates) stays untouched.
